<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 750 500" width="750" height="500">
  <rect width="750" height="500" fill="#ffffff" />

  <!-- Style definitions -->
  <style>
    text {
      font-family: Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
      font-size: 14px;
      fill: #000000;
    }
    .label {
      font-size: 14px;
    }
    .caption {
      font-size: 15px;
      font-weight: bold;
    }
    line, path, polyline, circle, rect, ellipse {
      fill: none;
      stroke: #000000;
      stroke-width: 2;
      stroke-linecap: round;
      stroke-linejoin: round;
    }
    .flawless-fill {
      fill: #ffffff;
    }
    .water-fill {
      fill: #e0f0ff;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- ==================== APPARATUS ==================== -->

  <!-- Bunsen Burner -->
  <!-- Base -->
  <ellipse cx="180" cy="420" rx="35" ry="8" class="flawless-fill" />
  <!-- Barrel -->
  <rect x="174" y="380" width="12" height="40" class="flawless-fill" />
  <!-- Collar / Air holes -->
  <rect x="172" y="395" width="16" height="10" class="flawless-fill" />
  <!-- Gas inlet tube -->
  <path d="M 174 410 Q 150 415 140 405" />

  <!-- Flame -->
  <path d="M 180 380 Q 195 320 180 280 Q 165 320 180 380" fill="#ffffff" stroke-dasharray="4,3" />

  <!-- Tripod Stand -->
  <path d="M 120 420 L 140 330 L 220 330 L 240 420" /> <!-- Back leg / top ring implied -->
  <!-- Gauze -->
  <line x1="130" y1="330" x2="230" y2="330" />
  <line x1="140" y1="335" x2="220" y2="335" stroke-dasharray="3,3" />

  <!-- Round-bottomed Flask -->
  <!-- Flask body and neck -->
  <path d="M 160 210 
           C 160 170, 200 170, 200 210
           C 200 240, 230 260, 230 285
           C 230 315, 130 315, 130 285
           C 130 260, 160 240, 160 210 Z" class="flawless-fill" />
           
  <!-- Side arm coming off the neck -->
  <path d="M 188 200 L 320 280" />
  <path d="M 180 215 L 312 295" />
  <!-- Cover end of side arm tube to make it look connected correctly -->
  <path d="M 184 207 L 180 215" class="flawless-fill" />

  <!-- Sea Water Liquid Level inside flask (wavy-ish surface) -->
  <path d="M 138 290 Q 180 300 222 285" class="water-fill" />
  <path d="M 138 290 C 138 315, 222 315, 222 285 Z" class="water-fill" />

  <!-- Rubber Bung / Stopper -->
  <polygon points="172,165 188,165 192,185 168,185" class="flawless-fill" />

  <!-- Thermometer -->
  <!-- Stem -->
  <rect x="177" y="90" width="6" height="110" class="flawless-fill" />
  <!-- Bulb -->
  <circle cx="180" cy="205" r="5" class="flawless-fill" />
  <!-- Mercury line -->
  <line x1="180" y1="208" x2="180" y2="110" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.5" />
  <!-- Temp markings hint -->
  <line x1="183" y1="120" x2="186" y2="120" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="183" y1="140" x2="186" y2="140" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="183" y1="160" x2="186" y2="160" stroke-width="1" />
  <line x1="183" y1="180" x2="186" y2="180" stroke-width="1" />

  <!-- Liebig Condenser (Apparatus X) -->
  <!-- Outer jacket -->
  <rect x="330" y="270" width="240" height="50" rx="8" class="flawless-fill" />
  
  <!-- Inner tube passing straight through -->
  <line x1="312" y1="295" x2="580" y2="295" />
  <line x1="312" y1="290" x2="580" y2="290" /> <!-- double line effect for glass, or just keep single clear path. Let's make inner tube distinct -->
  <!-- Actually let's redraw inner tube cleanly: -->
  <path d="M 312 291 L 580 291 M 312 299 L 580 299" class="flawless-fill" />

  <!-- Water In / Water Out nozzles -->
  <!-- Lower nozzle (Water In) at the right end of condenser -->
  <path d="M 545 320 L 545 345" />
  <circle cx="545" cy="345" r="3" />
  
  <!-- Upper nozzle (Water Out) at the left end of condenser -->
  <path d="M 355 270 L 355 245" />
  <circle cx="355" cy="245" r="3" />

  <!-- Rubber stoppers/adapters at ends of condenser -->
  <path d="M 310 280 L 330 270 L 330 320 L 310 310 Z" class="flawless-fill" />
  <path d="M 580 280 L 560 270 L 560 320 L 580 310 Z" class="flawless-fill" />

  <!-- Delivery Adapter (bend downwards to conical flask) -->
  <path d="M 572 295 C 590 295, 600 310, 600 330 L 600 365" />
  <path d="M 580 295 C 595 295, 604 310, 604 330 L 604 365" />
  <!-- Connect top part of adapter nicely -->
  <line x1="572" y1="295" x2="580" y2="295" class="flawless-fill" />

  <!-- Conical Flask -->
  <path d="M 575 425 
           L 585 365 
           L 615 365 
           L 625 425 
           C 625 432, 575 432, 575 425 Z" class="flawless-fill" />
  <!-- Neck rim -->
  <rect x="582" y="360" width="38" height="5" class="flawless-fill" />

  <!-- Pure Water Drops inside flask -->
  <circle cx="600" cy="415" r="2" fill="#000000" />
  <circle cx="595" cy="405" r="1.5" fill="#000000" />
  <path d="M 600 365 L 600 380" stroke-dasharray="2,2" /> <!-- dripping representation -->

  <!-- ==================== LABELS & POINTERS ==================== -->

  <!-- Thermometer label -->
  <text x="50" y="110" class="label">thermometer</text>
  <path d="M 135 110 L 175 110" />

  <!-- Apparatus X label -->
  <text x="400" y="240" class="label">X</text>
  <path d="M 412 245 L 430 280" />

  <!-- Water Out label -->
  <text x="310" y="215" class="label">water out</text>
  <path d="M 370 215 L 355 235" />

  <!-- Water In label -->
  <text x="560" y="375" class="label">water in</text>
  <path d="M 555 365 L 545 350" />

  <!-- Sea water label -->
  <text x="60" y="310" class="label">sea water</text>
  <path d="M 125 310 L 150 305" />

  <!-- Pure water label -->
  <text x="635" y="405" class="label">pure water</text>
  <path d="M 630 405 L 610 405" />

  <!-- Heat label -->
  <text x="170" y="465" class="label">heat</text>
  <path d="M 180 445 L 180 430" />

  <!-- Caption -->
  <text x="320" y="490" class="caption">Fig. 4.1</text>

</svg>
